cases.sentence: Когда Он приведет вас туда, соблюдайте в этом месяце такой обычай: 6 семь дней ешьте хлеб, приготовленный без закваски, а на ___ устраивайте праздник Господу.
cases.explain: «седьмой день» — after the preposition «на», the accusative marks the direct object of the verb.
cases.translation: It shall be, when Yahweh brings you into the land of the Canaanite, and the Hittite, and the Amorite, and the Hivite, and the Jebusite, which he swore to your fathers to give you, a land flowing with milk and honey, that you shall keep this service in this month.

cases.explain: «пресный хлеб» — the accusative marks the direct object of the verb.
cases.translation: Unleavened bread shall be eaten throughout the seven days; and no leavened bread shall be seen with you. No yeast shall be seen with you, within all your borders.

cases.sentence: Ведь Господь вывел вас из Египта ___.
cases.explain: «могучей рукой» — the instrumental marks the means, company, or complement.
cases.translation: It shall be for a sign to you on your hand, and for a memorial between your eyes, that Yahweh’s law may be in your mouth; for with a strong hand Yahweh has brought you out of Egypt.

cases.sentence: Все первенцы вашего скота ___ принадлежат Господу.
cases.explain: «мужского пола» — the genitive here marks possession, absence, or quantity.
cases.translation: “It shall be, when Yahweh brings you into the land of the Canaanite, as he swore to you and to your fathers, and will give it you,

cases.sentence: В будущем, когда сын спросит у тебя: «Что это значит?», — скажи ему: «Господь ___ вывел нас из Египта, из земли рабства.
cases.explain: «могучей рукой» — the instrumental marks the means, company, or complement.
cases.translation: It shall be, when your son asks you in time to come, saying, ‘What is this?’ that you shall tell him, ‘By strength of hand Yahweh brought us out from Egypt, from the house of bondage.

cases.sentence: Когда сердцем фараона завладело упрямство, и он не хотел отпускать нас, Господь погубил в Египте всех первенцев ___: и людей, и животных.
cases.explain: «мужского пола» — the genitive here marks possession, absence, or quantity.
cases.translation: When Pharaoh stubbornly refused to let us go, Yahweh killed all the firstborn in the land of Egypt, both the firstborn of man, and the firstborn of livestock. Therefore I sacrifice to Yahweh all that opens the womb, being males; but all the firstborn of my sons I redeem.’

cases.sentence: Вот почему я приношу в жертву Господу всех первенцев ___, а за своих первенцев отдаю выкуп».
cases.explain: «мужского пола» — the genitive here marks possession, absence, or quantity.
cases.translation: When Pharaoh stubbornly refused to let us go, Yahweh killed all the firstborn in the land of Egypt, both the firstborn of man, and the firstborn of livestock. Therefore I sacrifice to Yahweh all that opens the womb, being males; but all the firstborn of my sons I redeem.’

cases.sentence: Это будет как знак у тебя на руке, как свидетельство на лбу, что Господь ___ вывел нас из Египта.
cases.explain: «могучей рукой» — the instrumental marks the means, company, or complement.
cases.translation: It shall be for a sign on your hand, and for symbols between your eyes; for by strength of hand Yahweh brought us out of Egypt.”

cases.sentence: Бог повел народ в обход, пустынной дорогой к ___.
cases.explain: «Красному морю» — after the preposition «к», the dative marks the indirect object or recipient.
cases.translation: but God led the people around by the way of the wilderness by the Red Sea; and the children of Israel went up armed out of the land of Egypt.

cases.sentence: Днем Господь шел впереди них в ___, указывая им путь, а ночью — в огненном столбе, чтобы давать им свет, поэтому так они могли передвигаться и днем, и ночью.
cases.explain: «облачном столбе» — after the preposition «в», for location or topic.
cases.translation: Yahweh went before them by day in a pillar of cloud, to lead them on their way, and by night in a pillar of fire, to give them light, that they might go by day and by night:

cases.sentence: Ни ___ днем, ни огненный столб ночью ни разу не отошли от народа.
cases.explain: «облачный столб» — the subject of the sentence stands in the nominative.
cases.translation: the pillar of cloud by day, and the pillar of fire by night, didn’t depart from before the people.

cases.sentence: Ни облачный столб днем, ни ___ ночью ни разу не отошли от народа.
cases.explain: «огненный столб» — the subject of the sentence stands in the nominative.
cases.translation: the pillar of cloud by day, and the pillar of fire by night, didn’t depart from before the people.
